name: Ocean
summary: 以卡牌创造和角色互动为主题的游戏。官方披露 AI 图像、动态图像及部分实时交流内容；图像是否全部在游玩时生成未明确。

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 完整披露、身份和英文界面讨论区首页（3 个主题）。另读 3 个主题正文及可见回复。每款游戏单独检索公开报道；讨论区仅覆盖首页，搜索并非穷尽。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: OceanAI uses AI to generate images, animated images, and partial real-time communication content.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-29 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A collectible-card game built around card creation and character interaction. The disclosure covers generated images, animated images and some real-time communication, without fully specifying when the visual assets are generated.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam disclosure, identity and the discussion homepage in the English interface (3 visible topics). Also read 3 topics and all visible replies. Public coverage was searched separately for this game. Discussion coverage is limited to the homepage and search is not exhaustive. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: Some real-time communication content is AI-generated; the disclosure does not say all dialogue.
